describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dry, sparsely grassed ground. The front half, including the head, neck, chest and two large outspread wings, is covered in dense eagle-like plumage in golden-brown, dark brown and cream with a hooked beak and yellow eye, while the rear half, including the torso, four legs and long tail, is covered in short tawny lion-like fur with a lighter underbelly. The wings are raised and spread outward from the upper back, showing layered flight feathers darker at the tips. The overall build is muscular and lion-bodied with an eagle head held high.

describe.description: A large standing quadruped with the feathered head, chest and outstretched wings of a bird of prey merging into the furred body, legs and tufted tail of a large feline. The front upper part including the head, neck and chest is covered in brown, golden-brown and cream feathers, with a hooked beak and a fierce yellow eye, and two large spread feathered wings rise from the shoulders. The mid-body, hindquarters and four sturdy limbs are covered in short tawny fur with paler underparts and large pawed feet, ending in a long thin tail with a dark tuft.
